issue.description:

OG-SOL-002: State write follows an external call (high, medium confidence)

Analyzer 0.1.4 · solc (0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a.Linux.g++) · 12 rules · EffectVault.withdraw

EffectVault.sol:20:9 · bytes 557–591

An external interaction precedes a write to this contract's storage on a modeled execution path.

```
_send(payable(msg.sender), amount)
```

Suggested remediation: Apply checks-effects-interactions and verify a reentrancy guard with a local regression test.
